faq.q: How do I install Gardenscapes on Android?
faq.a: Open Google Play, search for Gardenscapes and check the developer is Playrix before tapping Install. Google Play only shows the Install button if your phone is compatible. It's free to install, and Play keeps it updated automatically. Avoid copies from other sites: they aren't from Playrix and may be altered, so the safest way to play Gardenscapes is the official listing.

faq.q: How do I earn stars in Gardenscapes?
faq.a: Finish match-3 levels. Each level gives a star, and stars pay for garden restoration tasks.

faq.q: Is Gardenscapes the same as Homescapes?
faq.a: They're made by Playrix and play the same way, but Gardenscapes focuses on restoring a garden while Homescapes renovates a house.
Google Play doesn't label it with ads. It earns money from in-app purchases of coins, lives and boosters.
